svg.aria-label: AWS architecture of driftfix. The customer's AWS account holds the CloudFormation stacks, CloudTrail, an S3 log bucket and a read-only IAM role. The driftfix account runs an EventBridge schedule and four Lambda functions that use DynamoDB, Bedrock, S3 and Secrets Manager, with SQS, CloudWatch and SNS for failures and monitoring, and an App Runner portal for onboarding. Pull requests go to the customer's GitHub repository.

svg.text: One manual change becomes a reviewed pull request in four serverless stages
driftfix on AWS: the customer account, the daily pipeline, and the services behind it
One IAM role per customer, assumed
with an ExternalId for one hour.
cfn-lint errors return to the model,
